title: Nonparametric Kernel Clustering with Bandit Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2601.07535v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clustering with bandit feedback refers to the problem of partitioning the arms of an $N$-armed stochastic bandit according to their underlying distributions, based on noisy observations collected sequentially and adaptively. This setting has attracted growing interest for its applicability in recommendation systems, crowdsourcing, and adaptive trials. Existing works rely on the strong assumption that arm distributions are sub-Gaussian, which can only distinguish arms whose distributions differ in mean - missing realistic settings where distributional differences lie in shape or higher moments. % We introduce a framework of \emph{nonparametric clustering with bandit feedback}, free of any parametric assumptions regarding the arm distributions. translated_title: 基于赌博机反馈的非参数核聚类
translated_abstract: 带赌博机反馈的聚类是指基于顺序且自适应收集的噪声观测，将N臂随机赌博机的各个臂按照其底层分布进行划分的问题。由于其在推荐系统、众包和适应性试验中的应用价值，这一设定引起了越来越多的关注。现有工作依赖于臂分布为次高斯分布的强假设，这只能区分均值不同的臂，而忽略了分布差异体现在形状或高阶矩的现实场景。我们引入了一个带赌博机反馈的非参数聚类框架，该框架对臂分布没有任何参数化假设。我们采用基于核的方法，将问题重新表述为根据臂在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中的核均值嵌入对臂进行聚类。在此表述基础上……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个对臂分布无任何参数化假设的非参数聚类框架，通过在再生核希尔伯特空间中对臂的核均值嵌入进行聚类，突破了现有工作依赖次高斯假设、仅能区分均值差异的局限，从而能够识别臂分布在形状或高阶矩上的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a nonparametric clustering framework with bandit feedback, free of parametric assumptions, which reformulates the problem as clustering arms by their kernel mean embeddings in an RKHS, thereby overcoming the sub-Gaussian limitation of prior work and capturing distributional differences in shape or higher moments.
